tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (243)de la 'dir bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che zur gnyis pa la don gnyis dang ldan pa ni/gzhan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'do
(243)de la 'dir bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che zur gnyis pa la don gnyis dang ldan pa ni/gzhan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'do

tei:div.tei:p: (243)de la 'dir bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che zur gnyis pa la don gnyis dang ldan pa ni/ gzhan sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ bla na med pa rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa de sems bskyed kyi ngo bo yin la/ de la rang gi blo sbyong tshe go bde bar mdor bsdu na/ zur dang po snying rje bsgom pa la/ sems can thams cad mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ snying rjes dmigs yul sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la bsam pa/ snying rje'i ngo bo'i rnam pa sdug bsngal bral bar 'dod pa bzhi'i sgo nas blo sbyong dgos/ de la mar shes par bya tshul ni/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mtha' gtug pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad rang dang 'brel ba yod pa'i don med zhig ma yin ste/ rang gi thog ma med nas pha mar ma byas pa ni gcig kyang med (244)par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis rnam mkhyen gyis mkhyen nas bden par gsungs pa'i mdo sde rnams las du mar gsungs pa la yid ches par bya zhing*/ khyad par du rang gis bsam nas nges par byas te/ rang gi skye ba 'di la thog ma med par dang phar srid pa 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams shing sems can 'dis lus ma blang bya ba dang*/ bde sdug 'di ma myong bya ba ni gcig kyang med par nges la/ de ltar skye shi'i kha brgyud tshe nam yang rdzus skyes sha stag tu skye ba ni med cing*/ de min gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang pha ma med dus ni med pas de'i don gyis na/ sems can thams cad pha mar yin nges shing*/ pha mar byas pa de yang lan gcig tsam ma yin te lan grangs dpag tu med par byas zhing*/ de yang mi lus gcig pu nyid du ma nges te/ mtho rgyal po dma' sprang po sogs dang tha na phyugs dud 'gro 'bu sgrang grogs sbur yan chad pha mar lan grangs du mar byas shing*/ lan gcig tsam (245)ma yin te lan grangs dpag tu med par byas/

da lta tshe 'di'i ma tsam gyis kyang rang gi de sngon lan grags dpag med/ mi dang dud 'gro sogs kyi mar byas pa'i mtha' mim mngon par nges shing*/ des na sems can spyi dang khyad par sdang dgra gnod byed 'dre btsan sogs la rang gi ma byas pa yang nas yang du bsam zhing*/ de yang sngar yang ma byas la da dung yang byang chub ma thob bar du ma 'ongs pa na mar bya bar nges pas/ de'i tshul rnams kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying nas bsam la rang gi blor ma dang bu'i 'du shes ma skyes bar du blo sbyong zhing*/ dus rtag tu sems can phra rag mthong tshad pha ma'i 'du shes bzung bar bya/ de ma yin par kha tsam tshig tsam gyis pha mar ma byas pa gcig kyang med bsam lo byas pas blo sbyong mi 'ong ngo*/ de nas drin dran tshul ni/ de ltar sems can thams cad pha mar byas nas drin chen pos ma skyong ba ni (246)gcig kyang med la/ da lta'i pha ma ltar shin tu drin che bar bsam dgos/ de yang khyad par tshe 'di'i pha mar drin shin tu che ste/ 'di ltar rang re rnams dang po ni/ 'di lta bu bzang po/ 'jigs pa/ gang yang byed nus pa de lta bu thor skyes sam nam mkha' las lhung 'ong ba lta bu ma yin/ dang po bar do'i yid lus 'khyams so zhig las dang rkyen gyi dbang gis da lta'i pha ma'i khu khrag gi bar du zhugs nas bzung*/ gcig pa'i lus 'di sha khrag gi dwangs mas bskyed/ zas bcud kyi dwangs mas gsos/ zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar mngal du bzung*/ ma rgan drin chen de'i lus sems sdug bsngal gyis gdung*/ phyir btsa' ba'i tshe tshor ba'i sdug bsngal brnag dka' ba myong zhing lus kyi rus mtshams phye ba lta bu'i gnod pa 'byung zhing*/ phyir skyes tsam nyid du bdag po ma byas na yun ring por mi thog par 'khyag ltog skom sogs kyis shi tshar nges pa la/ a ma (247)drin can mas rang gi sdug bsngal khyad du bsad nas/ rang shi min pos min lus bsgul bskyed tsam yang mi nus par 'di phyi gang yin ngo mi shes pa'i nyam chung de/

ma drin can mas mi gtsang pa thams cad chus bkrus/ lag pas phyis nas 'chir ma bcug par/ sor mo bcu'i dpang du blang lus kyi sha drod la gcar/ mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun/ mjum pa'i mdangs kyis bsus/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyang*/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ snyan pa'i ngag gis bos te/ a mi tshe ring rgyu/ nad med rgyu/ bkra shis rgyu/ skyid thob rgyu/ ci bsam 'grub rgyu/ gces phrug le lo/ se mo/ sems rten sogs kyis byams pa'i ngag gis ming btags pa'i tha na phyed tsam las brjod mi bra bar byas/ dus rtag tu bzang po zhig 'og du re/ ngan pa zhig byung gi dwogs te/ na ba'i dwogs/ shi ba'i dwogs/ mi 'dod (248)pa sna tshogs 'byung gi dwogs/ 'khyag ltog skom sogs kyis gnod pa 'byung bzhin ma rang shi ba las bu na bas thu ba'i sems kyis bskyang ste/ rgyun du tha na zas tsha mo phus btab/ grang mo mes bsros/ gro grang mdzub mos tshad bzung nas gnod pa phra mo kha tshig pa tsam yan la bskyab/ phan pa tha na lag mgo grang ba tsam tshun me dang lag pas bsros/ phrag la thog thod pa gtug 'o byas/ nam yang zas skom gang zhim gang gtsang gang bzang sogs kyis bza' btung gi phud byin/ gos gang bzang gang dro gang 'jam gang yag sogs kyis brtse g.yog par shin tu byams pas bskyed bsring de/ tha na gyen la ldang mi shes pa yang lag nas bzung ste lang 'dug bslab/ gtam smra bar mi shes pa nyid kyang rim gyis bslab te 'di la a pha/ 'di la a ma/ 'di la sa khu/ 'di la che ge mo dang*/ 'di la ming ga ge mo sogs so sor bslab/ gos kyi mgo 'jug (249)dang gyon tshul rke rag dang lham sgrog lugs/ bza' btung byed tshul phor ba khar tshad tshul sogs phra zhib du bslabs ste lo du mar bdag gi g.yog byed byed nas/ da ltar rang mgo rang gis thon gyi bar du bskyang ba yin/ a ma lta bu'i drin che ba su zhig gang na yod/

de ltar bskyangs dus yang re dgos grangs bsgrangs/ mi dang 'dzing*/ khyi dang 'thab/ tsha grangs 'khyag ltog sdig sdug dang gtam ngan/ ngal dub sogs khyad du bsad nas nyin mtshan rtag tu snying thang la lus pa lta bu'i gces par bskyang nas tha na mtshan mo gnyid zhabs su yang bdag gi don bsgrub pa sogs rmi ba lta bu'i brtse sems bzung na a ma de ci'i phyir drin mi che/ de nas lang tsho dar la babs nas bzung pha ma drin des sdig gla khrag gi mtshos thang gyis mi dge ba'i las ngan gang dang yang ma 'dzem par bsags bsrung spel bskyed sogs byed nas yar dkon mchog la (250)mchod pa/ mar ngan slong la sbyin ma bra bar gces par bzung ba'i zas gos dang gnas khang sa zhing dang nor rdzas sogs phyi dgra lta bus khab skud tsam mam dngos po phal ba tsam la gnod pa byas na rang gi gces pa'i srog btang thub pa de phang sems dang ser sna med par bdag gi chis dang bde ba'i rkyen la sbyar nas gang 'dod du longs spyod pa de lta bu+u byin pa'i drin che ba dang lan ring ba ci 'dra ba zhig yod/ da lta yang*/ rang re rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal/ theg pa chen po'i chos dang 'phrad/ 'khor 'das kyi skyon yod po blang dor gyi gnas shes/ bsgrub na rjogs pa'i byang chub sems gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde thob rung ba 'di yang don la a ma rin can mas dang po 'chi ba'i gnas las skyabs/ gson po tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad byin nas gso bskyed bsrung ba sogs byed pa'i drin yin na/ bdag la de lta bu'i 'phral dang yun du phan btag (251)bdag gis ni ma rgan sdug bsngal dang gnod pa la sbyar te/ bdag gi don du ma drin can des nyon mongs pa chags sdang rmongs gsum dang las ngan sna tshogs dpag med bsags/ tshe 'di la sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong zhing*/ phyi ma yang dmyal ba sogs ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba bdag gi rkyen gyis myong dgos na da ci tshugs byed ang*/

de ltar tshe 'di'i ma rgan bzhin du khams gsum gyi sems can spyi dang khyad par sdang dgra gnod byed 'dre btsan rgyal pa sogs kyis de bzhin du sngar yang drin gyis bskyang*/ ma 'ong pa na drin che b.ra'agyur/ da ltar yang rang re rnams kyi bza' ba'i zas/ skom pa'i btung ba/ bgo ba'i gos/ 'dod rgu'i yo byad/ 'dug pa'i gnas khang sogs mthun rkyen/ tshe 'dir gson pa yang sems can 'di rnams kyi drin gyis 'tsho ba yin la/ sngon nas da bar du (252)drin gyis bskyang bskyang ba'i tshe/ bdag la phan btags pa so de'i zas nor longs spyod rnams gcig tu bsdom na sa chen po 'dir mi shong zhing*/ tha na sems can re re'i mngar ba'i nu zho 'thung ba yang mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po las lhag par nges na de ltar drin che zhing*/ mthar yang byang chub ma thob bar du spyi yang de bzhin drin gyis skyong bar nges la/ khyad par du yang bla na med par sems bskyed pa dang rgyal sras kyis spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu spyod pa'i yul yang phyed sems can thams cad la rags las pas de ltar phan par drin che na da bdag gis drin lan de thabs gang ji lta bus bsags zhig 'ong*/ de lta bu'i drin can gyi sems can 'di rnams kyis gnod pa ji ltar byed rung*/ phan ji lta bus gdags nus/ ma rgan drin can 'di rnams shul du bskyur nas rang gcig pus 'phral dang yun tu zhi bde zhig bsgrub pas ci phan aṃ/ drin chen de rnams kyi phan pa'i don zhig ma bsgrub na de bas ngo tsha (253)ba dang khrol bor ba/ phan par mi bsam pa/ drin mi brtse ba byas pa mi bzo ba/ phyi thag thung ba'i tha chad pa su zhig yod na/ e ma bdag gis sems can gyi drin 'di bsab pa'i thabs ji drag gang gis phan/ ci tshugs byed/ nam zhig drin lan lon/ da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang byang chub chen po ma thob kyi bar du 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde la sbyar ba las gnod pa spu tsam yang byed ro shi/

ma sems can drin can 'di rnams kyi drin lan dam pa'i chos kyis mjal nus pa phan bde bla na med pas drin lan bsab nus pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje'i mthu dang nus pa ma chung zhig snyam du zhe gting nas lhang lhang dran par yang yang bya dgos/ drin drin pa de yang dang po rang gi tshe 'di'i ma rgan gyi drin gong bzhin du de bas zhib par bsam nas des mtshon nas sems can kun la dpag dgos pa yin pas de dang gzhan yang sems can mchog (254)dman 'bring gsum phyug dang tha na bya byis tshun chad mar byas nas ji ltar drin gyis bskyangs pa de rag rim dang*/ o zob kha zer tsam min par snying nas bsam dgos so/ dper na da lta'i ma'i drin yang yang bsam nas/ nges shes skyes tshe da lta ma rgan de gson na ji ltar bde sdug sogs myong gyin yod snyam pa dang shi nas gang du ji 'dra zhig rod yod snyam pa'i blo dang phan 'dod bcos min zhig ma 'ong bar du thang lhod med par bsam dgos/ de ltar byung ba dang khyad par sdang dgra sogs rang gi blor mi 'ong ba'i sems can rnams la sngon dang da bar sogs su bskyang ba'i drin bsam zhing blo sna gnyen por ma 'ong bar du bsam dgos/ lar da lta'i ma rgan gyi drin tsam yang mi shes mi bsam drin lan tshe 'di'i lto gos tsam gyis drin bsam pa'i bsam pa med par rang bzang po dang 'jigs 'jigs mgo ci thon/ rnyed dang grags pa sogs tshe 'di'i bya ba 'ba' zhig bsgrub nas ma rgan mug grir shi na yang sha tsha (255)med na dam pa'i chos kyis drin lan bsab pa dang*/ rang nge tshos gzhan sems can thams cad kyi drin bsam pa dang*/ drin lan mi bsab pa pha rir zhog da dung kha ngo mi tsha bar sems can thams cad drin che a ba ris zer mdog byed nas don la sems can rnams la g.yo sgyu dang mgo bskor sogs gnod pa ci thub byed pa 'di bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs khrel bar nges pa can red do/

de bas byams dang snying rje sogs dang rgyud la skye ba'i brtsa ba mar shes pa dang drin dran pa gnyis po 'di la rag las a yi pas go lo thos lo bsam lo dang gal chung byed pas mi 'ong ste sngon yang 'di ma bsam pas snying rje sogs til 'bru tsam chos dang mthun pa mi skye ba de 'dis lan pa yin/ mdor na dus rtag tu sems can mthong thos su gyur tshad ma dang*/ drin dran pa thung 'phral du ma 'ong bar blo sbyong dgos/ de ltar sbyong na nyon mongs pa dang las ngan gyi gnyen po (256)'dis kyang 'ong la su dang 'phrad rung phan btags pa las gnod pa bskyal thabs med par 'gro nges so/ ༈ de nas snying rje'i dmigs yul sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la bsam pa ni/ de lta bu'i ma rgan drin can gyi sems can thams cad de yang rtag tu bde skyid zhig myong bzhin yod snyam na ma yin te/ 'di ltar bdag gis ma rgan drin can de rnams kyi 'ga' zhig dmyal ba na sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas mnar ste/ de yang yang sos la sogs tshad dmyal brgyad na a ma rnams 'dug pa'i gnas dang*/ bza' btung gi longs spyod sogs lcags bsregs dang tho lum 'bar ba zang zhun dang khro chu khol ma/ gshag gtub bcar bsreg 'tshod pa sogs nyin mtshan skad cig kyang mi dal bar lus me nang du dper na mgar gyi sol phung du lcags bsreg pa ltar 'bar ba'i sdug bsngal bzod blag med pa myong bzhin/ ngag 'o dod 'bod gdong la mchi ma zag nas 'gro ldog lang lang byed pa dang*/ chu bur can (257)sogs grang dmyal brgyad du lus gcer bu gangs dang chab rab bu yug 'tshub pa'i khrod la gas brkyang bskum tsam gyi snang ba med par nyin mtshan rtag tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas lus kyi sha dang rus mtshams phye nas rtsa rgyus kyi 'brel ba tsam la thug par gas shing thor ngag nas a chu dang mkhun cing shugs ring 'byin pa tsam las gdang mim thon par bsgul bskyod tsam yang mi nus par srog ma chad tsam du lus pa dang*/

me mur gyi 'bos sogs nye 'khor ba dang nye tshe ba rnams lus mgo mjug med par 'bar ba dang*/ gshegs pa dang gcod pa/ mi gtsang bar bying ba g.yang du lhung sogs sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzod par shi na rung snyam pa'i tshor bas dus ring po bskal ba sogs su rgyun chad med par myong ba'i bdag gi ma rgan drin can de rnams kyis ci ltar du sdug bsngal de bzod nus e pha bo shi re sha ma tsha na/ de bzhin tu bdag gi a ma (258)drin mo 'ga' yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal myong de/ de yang yi dwags kyi yul na gnas pa'i ma rgan rnams 'dug pa'i gnas mi sug pa sdong dum dang tsher ma bye tshan 'bab pa'i khrod na lus rid cing nyams chung ba mgo dang gsus pa che zhing rke dang rkang lag phra ba mi sdug pa'i mtshan mas brgyan pa skra dang ba spu zang nge*/ lhu mtshams brdar ba'i bar me stag 'phro ga gdong mchi ma dang*/ ngag shugs ring dang ltog sgom gyi sgra skad sogs 'o dod 'bod bzhin du phyi nang gi sgrib pa can sogs ni/ zas dang skom lo dang zla bar ming tsam yang mi grags shing zad tsam rag kyang de las me 'bar ba sogs dang*/ 'ga' zhig rang gi rnag khrag ngar snab phyi sa dang gcin sogs yid du mi 'ong bar spyod bzhin du tsha grang bkres skom sogs dang*/ gzhan yang las kyi gshin rje rnams kyis brdung brdeg sogs gnod pas gdung zhing rtag tu zas skom yid la btang bzhin lus sems tshor ba mi zad pas shir ma btub (259)par lo grangs mong po'i bar du lus shing gnas pa dang*/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags 'dre btsan rgyal po sogs rtag tu bkres skom gyis sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag sngangs gsum mnan bskrad la sogs gnod pa du mas mnar zhing de rnams rtag tu gzhan la gnod par 'dod cing rgyu las ngan sna tshogs bsgrub pa dang skad cig kyang mi sdod par kun tu rgyu bzhin rang gi longs spyod rnams 'jigs pa dang nyams chung zhing sus kyang 'dre ngan nag ra ma zhes byams sems pra mo tsam yang med par skyabs mgon dpung gnyer dang bral ba'i a ma las ngan yi dwags kyi 'gro ba de rnams kye ma ci 'dra zhig red song la shi re aṃ/

de bzhin tu bdag gi ma rgan drin can du ma zhig dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal rang dbang med par myong de/ de yang dud 'gro bying na gnas pa'i gnas ni rgya mtsho dang gling bar nyi zla'i snang ba med par mun pa'i khrod na a ma rnams dud 'gro lus mi 'dra ba chu rta dang chu lug (260)nya dang sbal pa chu srin sogs phal cher lus dbang che bas 'gul bskyed tsam yang mi nus pa dang*/ de rnams rtag tu bkres skom tsha grang sogs dang khyad par du gcig gi gcig za zhing che bas chung bas za/ chung bas che ba 'bigs pa sogs dang lus non pa dang de'i bar du 'tha' pa dang*/ phan tshun brdung brteg sogs 'tshe ba du mas nyan cing rang bzhin du yang na bgang dang rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung shing klu rnams kyang bye tshan gyi char dang mkha' lding gi gnod pa sogs kyi snang ba'i sdug bsngal du ma myong bzhin du yod la/ da lta'i ma'i yul na gnas pa'i bdag po'i ma bzung ba'i kha 'thor ba'i rigs/ gcan gzan dang ri dwags bya rigs sogs ni gcig gi gcig za ba dang*/ bkres skom tsha grang sogs dang rngon pos rnyi sogs gsod thabs du mas 'tshe ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi skye rga na 'chi dpag tu med la/ bdag pos bzung ba'i rta phyug che phra rnams rang dbang med par bkol zhing khal 'gel ba dang*/ rmos rmo ba dang zho bzho ba spu btogs pa/ sna 'big pa bya gcod pa gsod pa dang gson khrag 'byin pa brdung brdeg sogs mngon (261)sum du mig mchi ma khrel/ rgyab chad glo bug rnyed rtsa phye/ spu nyag ma red dang tul thig pa red/ kha sna lces nyug bzhin kha rlang pa chil le/ dbugs rngam pa he re lus 'khyor yor yor byed kyang da dung lcags kyi brab/ rdo dang dbyug pas bsnun/ 'ga' zhig drin bcad bcad nas/ de nas sha dang ko bas don lo tshe sdig can shan pa'i lag tu gtad nas gsod skabs phyug de'i rang gi lus de sa 'og tu nub na rung snyam pa'i dngangs skrag yod bzhin mig sngo ce re lus gnam pa bsgyur rkang lag bcing*/

mchu thag pas dkris kha sna lag pas bkab rke ldog pas mnan bzhin 'gre ldog ling ling 'dar yam yam 'khun shig gdong mchi ma me ri/ rnga ma 'tshub kyi li li/ da dung srog chad long med par byang khog gris gshags nas khrag rtsa 'don pa sogs sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi bzad pa de lta bu myong ba'i ma rgan mo drin can de'i las ci 'dras lus ngan dang gnas rim ngan pa dud 'gro'i lus (262)thob a pha pho da bdag cis ci ltar byas nas drag a tsa ma snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du bdag gi a ma drin can rnams mi'i gnas na sdug bsngal ches mang ba myong ste/ de yang 'ga' zhig skye ba'i sdug bsngal dri za'i rnam shes ma'i mngal du zhugs nas rnam shes dang lus dang las rlung rnams yan lag dang nang khrol mig dbang sogs ma grub bar du/ gtor bshig bsdus bsrub bzhin du zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar du mngal dog pa dang dri nga ba dang non bar du 'thag pa tsha grang sogs sdug bsngal myong bzhin dbugs 'thum nas shi ma thub tsam du lus pa nyid phyir btsa' tshe las rlung gis mgo mjug bzlog nas lcags kyi 'jur mig nas bton pa ltar gnod la de nas rang mgo ma thon bar du na tsha dang bkres skom tsha grang dang gnod pa sogs ci byung yang ngu ba tsam las byed thabs bral/ 'ga' zhig dus kyi 'gyur bas lang tsho yar na rgas pa'i sdug bsngal zhing*/ de yang lus kyi rus mgo lpags pas g.yogs/ gnyer ma shig ge rtsa rgyus sngo bring nge*/ (263)rked pa rgur/ lhu tshig 'gyur/ mig 'grib/ rna ba 'on/ sna zhom/ lce ldib/ dran pa rmongs/ skra dkar/ dung po bud/ bkrag mdangs nyams/ sdod tshe sa do chad pa lhung*/ ldang tshe sug bzhi sa la btsug nas bsgul bskyod ci byed na shug ring 'don zhing mkhar ba la brten/ su dang 'phrad rung kun gyis shi na rung snyam pa las gson na snyam pa med la/ skor re rang gi yang gson pa bas nyin snga dro tsam shi na dga' zhing rtag tu mi dang lha'i gral nas bud bzhin nyin mtshan du shes pa bying rmugs dang 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig gis snga phyi bar gsum gyi bya ba la ma red ma thang snyam pa las/

don dang bya ba ci yang rtsal zhog pa dang rang la dgos rgyu maid pas da shi na gson na ci bya snyam pa'i sgas pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas non/ 'ga' zhig lus kyi 'byung ba rnams phan tshun cha ma snyom par rlung mkhris bad kan sogs dang 'go ba'i nad rigs mje rigs rims na sogs dang klu dang gnyan rigs kyi (264)nad drag pos lus kyi stobs nyams/ rus mgo lpags pas g.yog dpyi mgo rdol/ ro smad mi gtsang bas gos/ sngas kha lud dkar dmar sngo nag gi gang*/ dri mi zhim pa'i ngad ldang*/ gdong dri nag dang mchil mas g.yog kha skom/ mig rtsa ngan/ smre sngags dang shugs ring a tsha dang a na/ shi ba rung gi sgra 'don cing rgyun du yod pa'i re ba dang 'chi ba'i dgos pas non la/ tha na lus brgul bskyod tsam yang mi nus par g.yas g.yon steng zhabs gang nas yang mi bde lam lam/ na tsha kam kam gzer ling ling*/ lus mi bde la sems sdug bsngal gyis gdung shing zas skam sogs yid gar mi 'ong kha tsha skyur gsum dang gtar bsreg sogs mi 'dod bzhin myong zhing nyin mtshan med par ngang pa skrag 'jigs snang dang lceb snying 'dod cing gson pa bas shi ba 'dam pa tsam dang sdang dgras mthong na sha tsha ba las med pa'i sdug bsngal myong*/ 'ga' zhig 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis non te/ (265)mal gyi tha mal du lus kyi gzhog g.yas phab ste gos rnying kyi tha ma la sogs kyis dkris/ zas skom gyi yi ga ni chad/ lus kyi stobs dang bkrag mdangs ni yal/ da dung gson pa'i re bas phyogs kun tu bla ma dang sman pa sogs la skyabs tshom snying ni 'dod/ gson pa'i re ba ni chad/ sman dang zas skom phor ba rnams ni klas la bor/ skrag cing bred pa'i bzhin mi dga' bas mig bgrad/ kha ni skom/ mig mchi ma khra chem me/ gces pa'i gnyen bshes dang zas gos yo byad kyi 'byor ba sogs tshe 'di'i snang ba dang 'bral ba'i dgos pas yi ni mug 'chi ba dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal la dwogs pas snying ni mi dga'/

yan lag ni g.yob/ shes pa brtsing*/ 'du shes ni 'khrugs/ snang ba ni 'khrul/ kha chu dang sna chu ni zag sngon las ngan ci byas kun dran pas dngangs/ gshin rje rnams kyi mi sdug pa'i bzhin ni mthong*/ dmyal ba'i me dang 'o dod kyi sgra ni thos pas skrag mi gtsang (266)bas lus la ni gos/ dbugs ngar ngar po ni 'don/ 'byung ba'i thim sdud dang srog chad pa'i gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rang gcig pus myong bzhin 'grogs pa'i gnyen bshes/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad ci yang med par gcig pur gcer bu lag stong nyid du skyabs mgon dpung gnyen kun dang bral nas rang 'chi ba lta zhog de lta bu zhig mthong na snying rlung ldang ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong*/ mi la la ni dgra dang 'phrad pa'i dgos pa dang*/ dgras bcom pas mi bsad/ nor de/ gnas khang bsreg yul phud pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal/ la la ni mthun pa'i gnyen bshes sdug pa rnams dang 'bral ba dang na tsha dang shi chad rgyu zas kyi gyong god kha sogs kyis sdug bsngal/ la la ni mi 'dod pa'i dgra rkun dang rgyal po'i chad pas nor 'phrogs pa lcags kyis grab pa/ gnam dpyang btson rar btsud/ rkang lag gcod pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal/ la lar 'dod pa'i zas gos nor sogs thog tu mi khel ba'i sdug bsngal/ (267)yod po rnams 'tsho bsrung dang chog mi shes pa'i sdug bsngal/ med po rnams yongs su tshol ba'i dbul phong gi sdug bsngal/ khyad par du mgon med pa'i sprang po rnams ni/ 'dug pa'i gnas ni med/ 'grogs pa'i gnyen bshes dang bral/ bza' ba'i zas/ skom pa'i btung ba/ gyon pa'i gos/ 'dug pa'i lam stan/ bdag pa rgu'i yo byad thams cad kyis dbul zhing rgyun du/ skar rjen gyi zhwa byed/ rkang ba mos l+h+wam byed/ gdong sha mi la byin/ nywa sha khyi la byin/ rkang khrag sa la brdab/ lag khrag rdo la brdab/ dus rtag tu zas gos gzhan la re/ gzhan gyis brnyas bcos dang khyad gsod/

tshig ngan dang brdung brdeg za rgyu dang gon rgyu ma rnyed nas ngus pa'i mchi ma rnams gsog rgyu yod na mtha'i rgya mtsho bas mang*/ 'khyag grir ltog grir shi ba grang gis mi chod/ mtsher shul dang mgron po theg shul na ja lo dang stan chad re lhung yod na sgum/ skyobs pa'i mgon ni med/ (268)'grogs pa'i grogs ni med/ phan pa'i bshes ni med/ bsags pa'i nor ni med/ brag phug dang grogs stong dang shing drung re la gnas bcas nas sdug bsngal bas ma rgan de rnams kyi bdag gi ched du ser sna byed pa'i lhag ma da lta 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba yin na da ci drag na thabs ci yod na snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du ma rgan drin mo che de dag gi la la ni lha ma yin gyis gnas su skyes nas dpal 'byor longs spyod cung re yod kyang sngon bsags mi dge bas phrag dog dang 'thab rtsod la gom pas lus rten de bzung tsam nas phrag dog pa'i 'du shes rags/ rang gnas na sde ris rtsod/ phan tshun 'thab rtsod kho nas dus 'da'/ lha'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa la phrag dog dang*/ dpag bsam gi shing gi rtsa ba lha min gyi yul la zug kyang 'bras bu lhas longs spyod pa la ma bzod nas lha dang g.yul 'gyed par chas pa na lha rnams kyis rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal nas go cha sra ba gyon/ (269)mtshon cha rno ba dag thog nas glang po che rab brtan gyis mgo sum cu po gsum la nye dbang po gnyis brgya byin dang bcas pas zhon nas/ lha'i dmag gi lung dang bcas nas gu bswo cha sgra dang bcas gzi brjid bzod par dka' bas ri rab la thur du sbub nas 'ong ba dang*/ 'thab pa'i tshe lha'i rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang mdung thung dang mda' bo che la sogs pa char bzhin du 'bebs pas 'jam zhing 'ong ba dang*/ lha rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas ri chen po rnams pas pas btegs nas tso par 'phen pa dang*/ rnga bo che'i brdung ba'i sgra nam mkha'i dkyil ral ba snyam byed pa dang*/

'thab pa'i tshe sdar ma 'ga' zhig gi ni bog cing brgyal nas gson po'i re ba dang bral/ lha'i glang po kun skyong gi sna la ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor nas mngag pas lha ma yin 'bum phrag mang po gsod cing ri rab gyis ngos nas sbab ru bsgril te/ rol mtsho dang po khrag mdog ru snang ba dang shul mi rnams (270)kyi mtsho rab snang la bltas te lha ma yin gyi legs nyes 'char bas de la bltas pas dmag mi rnams mgo dang yan lag chad nang khrol rnams phyir bud khrag gi rgyun babs bzhin ri rab kyi ngos la rbab tu 'gril ba mthong*/ smre ngag nga 'o dod 'bod pas sdug bsngal/ de ltar bu'i ma drin mo che thams cad sdug bsngal de dang bral ba'i thabs ci drag na/ bya thabs gang zhig yod na snyam nas bsam mo/ yang ma drin mo che la la ni mtha' bral gyi gnas gsum pa lha'i gnas su skye nas bde ba cung zad re myong yang yengs ma lam tshe zad nas 'chi ba'i rtags rnams shar nas lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis/ 'ob bdun dang rwa ba bdun gyi phyi rol bskyal nas me tog re dor nas/ khyod 'di nas 'phos te mi yul du skye nas dge ba bcu spyad nas slar yang 'dir skye bar shog cig ces smon lam btab nas klas la bor nas lha'i zhag bdun te mi lo bdun brgya la sogs pa'i bar la 'pho ba dang ltung ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis kas snying (271)la zin nas/ kyi hud lha'i bu/ kyi hud lha'i bu mo/ kyi hud lha'i gos/ kyi hud lha'i bdud rtsi/ kyi hud lha'i dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa'i smre sngags 'don bzhin longs spyod thams cad blos ni mi thongs/ rjes su ni mi 'brang bzhin ru mar par gyi gong bu rdo tshan du bzhag pa bzhin lus myang ngan gyis zhu zhing sdug bsngal/ gzugs gzugs med gnyis ting nge 'jin la 'byams nas skal chen brgyad cu lon pa'i dus don med par gron nas gnyid sad pa bzhin 'og tu lhung ba'i sdug bsngal yod pas de lta bu'i ma rgan de rnams sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar gyur cig

bral na ci ma rung*/ sdug bsngal de dang bral ba zhig bdag ngas byed snyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras de dang bral ba zhig mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar 'gro ba'i gnas ris gang na bdag gi a ma drin can sems can de dag rtag par 'khor yug kun tu sdug (272)bsngal snga ma ma sangs phyi mas non/ 'ga' zhig ngal bso'i bde ba phra mo re yod pa yang mim rtag par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir/ phal tsher phyi ma'i sdug bsngal 'du byed pa'i sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin sdug bsngal gyi yo lang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rten dang gnas/ sdug bsngal gyi 'byung khungs dang longs spyod/ me 'ab dang spu gri'i so bar/ gcan gzan dang mi rgod kyi khrod lta bu/ thar med kyi btson khang du tshud de sdug bsngal snga mas bskyal phyi mas bsus bar du mtshams sbayar te 'khyams kyang*/ da dung yang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bdag da bdag gir bzung ba'i dbang gis rang dbang med par nyon mongs pa spyi dang khyad par 'dod chags kyi rgya mtshor byin/ zhe sdang gi me 'bar/ gti mug gi mun pa 'thib/ nga rgyal gyi ri gzing*/ phrag dog gi rlung gi brdas/ ser sna'i mdud pas bsdoms bzhin las ngan mi dge ba sna tshogs la spyod cing*/ rgyun du 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba (273)bsgrub tshul la ni rmongs/ mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba spang ni mi shes par zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song zhing*/ blang dor gyi gnas yang dag par ston pa'i lam mkhan dge ba'i bshes dang ni bral/ rang stobs kyis blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mig ni long*/ dge ba'i phan yon dang de bsgrub pa'i tshul/ sdig pa'i nyes dmimags dang de spang tshul rnams ni mi shes/ yang dag pa'i lam dang lam ma yin pa'i gnad ni mi shes/ brgya lam shes kyang yang dag pa'i chos ni mi bsgrub/

log pa'i lam 'khor ba'i bya ba la ni brtson/ su dang 'phrad rung sdig pa'i grogs po'i bsnon mor du ni song*/ las tshad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu/ byas tshad don med/ bsgrub tshad las ngan/ 'bad tshad log lam/ bsam tshad 'khrul ba/ dran tshad phyin ci log tu song bas ngan song gi sgo ni phyes/ mtho ris kyi skad ni chag thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam dang ni bral cing (274)'khor ba'i gnas ris 'di na zo chu'i khyud mo shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin du sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis nyams thag cing skyabs dang skyob pa mgon dang dpung gnyen rten dang gnas thams cad dang bral ba'i a ma drin can de rnams snying re rje na/ sha re tsha na/ ya re nga na/ yi re mug na/ da ci byed dgos na/ thabs ci drag na/ byed thabs ci yod na/ pha bo sdug go snyam du snying gi khung rus pa'i gting nas lus kyi ba spu gzing*/ mig rtsa mchi mas 'khrugs bzhin sdud 'ong sa zhig yang yang bsam dgos/ ༈ de nas snying rje'i ngo bo'am rnam pa ni 'bral 'dod yin pas/ de ltar sdug bsngal la dmigs nas sha tsha ba tsam dang*/ sdug bsngal dran pa tsam gyis mi 'ong ste/ ma rgan drin can nyams thag pa 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pas rang dbang med par las snang log pa'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs la spyod pa de ci nas bral bar gyur cig bral na (275)ci ma rung*/ bral ba zhig bdag gis bya/ bdag gis ma sdug bsngal de dag bral ba'i mthu dang*/ stobs dang*/ thabs dang*/ nus pa nam zhig na yod 'ong nam zhig nas sdug bsngal las skyobs nus/ dus nam zhig na sdug bsngal de dag bsam thub/ da lta bdag la ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal las skyobs pa'i mthu dang nus pa stobs dang thabs gang yang med nges na/ de lta bu'i ma drin can rnams sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis las bral ba'i mthu stobs dang nus pa thugs rje can drin can bla ma dang mchog gsum rin po che la mnga' na/

mgon po thugs rje can rnams kyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di dang bral ba zhig thugs rje dang mthu dang nus pa ma chung cig da ni bdag gis ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i mthu dang stobs dang thabs dang nus pa mnga' ba zhig ci nas kyang srog la babs na yang brtson par bya'o snyam du shes pa grung thon pa zhig yang yang sems kyi gting nas bsam (276)par bya/ de ltar sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal de rtsing por ma song bar zhib tu bsam dgos la/ de yang tha ma sdug bsngal phra mo tsher ma zug pa tsam dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sems can la 'tshe ba phra mo khros pas sdang mig blta ba tsam tshun la dmamigs nas bral 'dod kyi snying rje la blo sbyong*/ snying rje de yang 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong ba rnams las khyad par du sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las ngan dang nyon mongs pas gdung ba rnams las lhag par yang snying rje bskyed dgos la/ de ma yin par da ltang snying rje dang chags sdang nor nas/ dper na sems can sngon cig gsod pa lta bul mtshon na gsod rgyu'i phyug la snying rje byed mdog dang gsod mkhan gyi shan pa la khro ba bskyed pa dang nad pa la snying rje dang nad bdag la khro bas bskrad brdung dang bsregs mnan sogs byed pa lta bu ni chags sdang rang rgyud pa ma gtogs byang sems kyi snying rje'i phyogs tsam la mi 'gro nges pa yin pas de'i khyad par 'byed pa gal che/ gong du (277)bshad pa des mtshon nas 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal che phra thams cad la zhib tu yang yang bsam dgos ma gtogs kha tsam gyi sems can sdug bsngal ba a ba ris zer mdog tsam dang*/ skor re kham 'dus pa'i sems rtsa sdug ha le ba re dang sems can sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i rkyen gyis sha tsha na snyam pa'i nyi tshe bas snying rje khyad 'phags zhig mi 'byung ngo*/ des khyad par du dang po rang gi rtsa ba'i ma rgan de dngos su mdun du bsam la drin khyad par du tshe bar bsam rjes 'di phyi kun tu sdug bsngal mi bzod pa myong tshul dang rtag tu nyon mongs pa dang las ngan 'ba' zhig gis mnar ba rnams snying nas bsam la ma rgan de'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras de nyid cis kyang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bcos min skyes tshe/

de nas rim par pha dang gnyen bshes rnams dang 'gro ba bar ma rnams dang dgra sogs la snying rje sbyong*/ nam yang dang po snying rje skye sla ba'i yun ring gi nad pa zung zad dang*/ sprang po nyam thag sogs (278)sdug bsngal drag po myong ba rnams blo yul du bsam/ de bral 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom na blo 'byong sla bar bshad do/ mdor na sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje 'di ni sdug bsngal rtsi bsam thub pa de tsam gyi snying rje 'byung ba dper bud shing ci tsam mang bzhin me chen lhag par 'bar ba ltar yin pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal sems thog tu mi bzod pa shug drag po yun ring du bsam pa ni blo sbyong ba gsar ba rnams kyis gal che/ de ltar ma yin par sems rtsa sra gan ne bar/ mig zum mo byed mdog dang*/ khas snying rje zer tsam kyis khyad par 'phags pa can gyi snying rje rnam dag mi 'byung ba yin no/ de ltar blo sbyong pas sems can gang mthong thos su gyur tshad kyi sdug bsngal myong ba rnams dang las ngan bsags pa rnams bral 'dod kyi blo nam yang yug 'phrad du bya zhing su la yang sdug bsngal byung ba de rang gi mi 'dod pa de lta bu ma byung gi bar snying rje kho na la blo sbyong dgos/ 'di byang chub kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin pas gal chung mi byed de/ rgyu med par 'bras bu byang (279)sems rin pa che mi 'byung nges can yin no/ ༈ de nas zur gnyis pa rdzogs byang thob 'dod la bsam tshul ni/ dmigs yul dang rnam pa gnyis yod/ dmigs yul ni/ de ltar snying rje dung dung ma bskyed nas/ de ma rgan sems can thams cad gnas skabs lha mi'i bde 'bras dang*/ thar pa nyan rang gi zhi bde phra mom tsam thob 'dod dang 'god 'dod kyi byams sems tsam gyis mi 'ong de/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'apang la dmigs dgos/ bla na med pa'i go 'phang de ni 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/

'di ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ni spang rtogs mthar phyin pa/ rang don chos sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs sku'i phun sum tshogs pa ye shes dang phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing sku rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa/ khyad par mtshan sum cu dang dpe byad brgyad cu sogs sku'i yon tan dang*/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab cing gsung rnam pa thams (280)cad dang ldan pa/ khyad par tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu sogs gsung gi yon tan/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ thugs rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa/ khyad par du stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs bzhi/ ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi nang tshan rtogs pa ma 'dres pa sogs thugs kyi yon tan mdor na chags thogs med pa'i mkhyen pa/ phyogs ris med pa'i thugs rje/ tshad med pa'i nus mthu/ 'bad rtsol med pa'i phrin las sogs rtag khyab lhun grub chen po'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ sangs rgyas ces pa'i sgra tsam thos na yang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing byang chub kyi sa bon thob pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa'i go 'phang la dmigs nas rnam pa ni ma rgan drin can kyi sems can de thams cad de ltar yon tan bsam mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi chos can chos kyis rgyal po de'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig thob na ci ma rung thob pa zhig bdag gis bya/ bdag gis sems (281)can thams cad byang chub sems chen po de la 'god pa'i thabs dang stobs mthu dang nus pa khyad par can la btson par skyed/ da ltar der 'god pa'i nus pa cang ma mchis kyang*/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang de sgrub ci thob par byas te/ ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gcig kyang ma lus par byang chub chen po la bkod par bya'o/ de lta bu thob cing don don byed nus par drin can gyi bla ma dam pa dang mchog gsum gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu dang stobs ma chung cig snyam du snying khung rus pa'i gting nas yang yang bsam dgos/

de ltar blo 'byong sla ba'i phyir dang po rtsa ba'i ma rgan pha rgan sogs dang*/ khyad par sdang dgra gnod byed rnams la thob 'dod yang yang sbyong zhing*/ sems can che phra mig gi mthong tshad/ rna bas thos tshad dang bzang ngan gyi 'brel thob sogs kyis byang chub thob 'dod dung dung ba bskyed cing kun la thug 'phrad du bya'o/ mdor bsdu na ma rgan drin can gyi (282)sems can thams cad srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bla na med par thob par gyur cig snyam du bsam pa de yin la/ de la snying nas blo sbyong mi byed par/ kha tsam tshig tsam skor re tsam bsam lo byas mdog byed pas sbyong pa sngon song min na snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can mi 'byung thag chod yin pas dus rgyun thug du gcod cing blo sbyong*/ rjes kyi bya ba 'gro 'dug za nyal sogs la mi brjed par bya/ khyad par gzhan don gyi gzugs bsnyan dang shi gson gyi yon 'bul dgra dang 'dre btsan rgyal 'gong sogs kyi 'tshe ba spyi dang*/ lhag par rang na shi sogs las ci la bab/ ji ltar byas rung byang chub kyi sems bsam pa bzang po 'di la blo gtad gzhi bzung*/ sems la bcag blo yul du bsam la/ 'di dang nam nga mi 'bral bar lus dang grib ma lta bu zhig cis kyang gal che nges pa yin/ de ltar blo sbyong tshe thun re'i nang spyir zur gnyis dang ldan par byas la khyad par thun dang po lta bu/ (283)zur dang po'i mar shes pa tsam rgyal sar bsam la/ gzhan drin dran pa sogs bsdu zhing snga mar rgyas par bsam pa rnams thun phyi mar bsdu ba sogs dus skabs dang rang gi blo dang khams kyi lcog tshod dang bstun nas nam yang dmigs rnam gsal tshe mi zhen par/ thun thung grangs mang shug grags gsal nges par bya ba dang spyod lam kun dang bsres la bslab par bya'o/ de ltar sbyong pas nang du bsam pa bzang po yod pa'i rtags phyi la ngom mi dgos par rang bzhin gyis lus ngag yid gsum lhod kyi legs par gnas/

gang du bsdad rung byang sems kyi ngang*/ su dang 'phrad rung bsam bzang lam lam/ gang dang 'brel rung smon lam gyi stobs kyis 'brel tshad don ldan ci ltar byas rung*/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa gang ltar bsgrub rung gzhan don gyi bya ba sogs dang don la pha gsod kyi lam dmar dang 'phrad rung bsam bzang las bsam ngan mi 'ong bar zhig ma 'ong bar du blo sbyong dgos par gsung*/ de ltar min par ming byang sems dang blo sbyong ba dang chos pa'i (284)ming btag de'i go sar bsdad nas don la 'dun ma tshe 'dir lto gos la gtad/ bsam sbyor gnyis ka tha mal du shor nas nam yang gang du bsdad rung mi bde lam lam/ su dang 'phrad rung khong khro dang gdug rtsub ngam ngam/ ji ltar bsam rung gnod 'dod dang rked tshol/ ci smras tshad tshig rtsub dang zur za/ bdag bstod gzhan smod/ ci byas tshe 'di/ ci bsgrub mi dge ba dang*/ 'phrad tshad log lam du bsgyur nas phyi tshul 'chos ltar bcos pa'i 'dra 'bag 'dis ni/ rang gzhan gnyis gar phung ba dang*/ bstan pa'i bla btsong bdag 'dra las mi 'ong thag chod red lags/

zhes pa 'di shākya'i dge slong dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po thub bstun lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mjad pa yin par 'dug ste/ phyag bris dngos su snang ba las drin chen de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i btsun gzugs thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis bsdus te bris pa dge legs 'phel/ maṅga lam/ dge'o/// /
